title: asdv
author: AI Weaver
victim: asdv Foundry (payroll and sealed contract envelope stolen)
intro_narrative: Under a bruise-colored sky, the asdv Foundry wakes to panic: payroll and sealed contracts vanished from an office safe left open—no pry marks, no broken lock. Inspector Mara Venn and Sergeant Len Croft must decide whether the theft came from outside or from someone who knew the safe, the shift rhythms, and the soot-slick routes to the river.

required_motive: Coerced by leverage over his sister and wartime papers; stole payroll for cash and held contracts to pressure the owners.

phases.name: Smoke-Gray Morning
phases.objective: Assess the safe room and identify whether the thief had inside knowledge.

phases.name: Soot Trails
phases.objective: Trace movement paths (handcart/river) and pressure the initial suspect list.

phases.name: Midnight Treatment
phases.objective: Confirm the burn story and link injuries to the theft timeline.

phases.name: Corridor Cache
phases.objective: Recover the missing contracts packet and assemble an impossible timeline to force a break.

asdv Railway Spur.description: A cold wind scrapes down the spur, rattling empty freight cars. Sooty gravel, rail ties, and a lone handcart track cut through the grime toward the river.
clues: At the railway spur, a handcart track shows it was pushed toward the river, not toward the road.

  |                         |
==+========= RAILS =========+==
  |   gravel & cinders      |
  |  handcart grooves  >>>  |
  |________to river_________|
   (road)            (towpath)

visual_metadata.setting: Industrial rail spur with idle cars, cinder ballast, and wind-driven grit.

connections.mechanism: Cinder path under a soot-black fence

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: along the outer edge of the spur

asdv Foundry Office.description: Coal heat clicks in iron radiators. A battered desk and adding machine sit under a grease-smudged calendar. The safe is set into masonry, its door hanging open like a missing tooth.
clues: The foundry office safe door is open without pry marks, suggesting a key or correct combination.
A faint oily smear crosses the safe dial, consistent with gloved hands used in a workshop.
A torn scrap of brown wrapping paper bears the partial stencil 'ASDV' used on foundry shipping crates.

  +----door to corridor--------+

visual_metadata.setting: Cramped administrative office: coal warmth, paper dust, and soot tracked in from the works.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: right of the desk near the safe wall

asdv Workers' Locker Room.description: Narrow, damp, and close with sweat and soap. Dented lockers line the wall; a long bench runs down the middle, boots tucked beneath like guilty thoughts.
clues: In the locker room, one worker's boots are freshly scrubbed but still smell of river mud.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: center of room beneath the long bench

asdv Clinic.description: A narrow clinic with frosted windows. Disinfectant fights a losing battle against coal smoke tracked in on boots. The counter is neat; the hours are not.
clues: A clinic nurse confirms someone arrived with a fresh forearm burn shaped like a hot metal edge.

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: behind the counter under a small shelf

St. Brigid's Church (asdv).description: Dim stone and candle wax. Damp cold clings to the pews. A side table holds envelopes and a ledger opened to neat lines of debt—and sudden relief.
clues: A church donation ledger shows an anonymous cash gift made the morning after the theft—too large for a laborer.

asdv Boarding House.description: A long corridor of peeling paint and steam heat. Radios murmur behind thin doors; kettles begin to sing. The radiator clanks like it knows too much.
clues: The critical evidence item 'asdv' is found wedged behind a radiator in the boarding house corridor.

visual_metadata.setting: Shared living in a hard town: thin privacy, loud pipes, and hiding places that belong to everyone.

connections.mechanism: Short walk via the parish wall
Alley to the back lane and river steps

objects.hidden_by: the radiator body and a loose wall board

asdv Riverside Towpath.description: The towpath runs slick with algae. The river moves slow and dark, reflecting broken warehouses and the foundry’s distant chimneys. Reeds snag anything that wants to be forgotten.
clues: A foundry time clock card was punched for a break that doesn't match witness statements.

  |  slick towpath (algae)    |
  |  scuffs where cart tipped |
  |  warehouses (shadows)     |

connections.mechanism: Gravel footpath beside a bent fence

surfaces_and_containers.spatial_relationship: near the waterline beside the scuffed towpath

Inspector Mara Venn.role: Lead investigator; patient, methodical, builds a chain of facts to corner the thief.
Inspector Mara Venn.persona: Measured, incisive questions; speaks plainly, never raises her voice; narrates deductions as if writing a report.

knowledge_about_others.Sergeant Len Croft: Reliable muscle and memory for details; tends to push for direct confrontation.
knowledge_about_others.Elsie Marrow: Clerk under pressure; knows access lists and routines; anger is covering fear.
knowledge_about_others.Dr. Havel Rusk: Company doctor; cautious about reputations; will disclose only what is necessary.
knowledge_about_others.Father Kellan: Hears what the town won’t say to police; protective of anonymity but hates hypocrisy.

Inspector Mara Venn.abilities: Can synthesize clues into an accusation sequence; can request records (clock cards, clinic log, donation ledger) once unlocked by phase.

required_knowledge: River-mud boots and cart track to towpath
conditional_behaviors.reaction: Mara lays the evidence in a strict timeline, highlighting the impossible overlap between the punched break and the clinic visit, then demands the suspect explain the contracts behind the radiator.

Sergeant Len Croft.role: Field sergeant; interviews workers, spots physical traces, and backs Mara during confrontations.
Sergeant Len Croft.persona: Blunt, practical, protective; prefers concrete details—tracks, scuffs, timing—over speculation.

knowledge_about_others.Inspector Mara Venn: Builds cases that hold up; Croft trusts her pacing.
knowledge_about_others.Elsie Marrow: Knows who handles shipping and after-hours routines; defensive but sharp.
knowledge_about_others.Dr. Havel Rusk: Keeps secrets to protect the firm; may minimize injuries.
knowledge_about_others.Father Kellan: Not a liar, but will ration information unless pressed carefully.

Sergeant Len Croft.abilities: Can intimidate lightly to speed answers; can secure scenes and prevent suspect flight during Phase 4.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Croft positions himself between the suspect and the door once the contracts packet is produced.

Dr. Havel Rusk.role: Company doctor; present at the foundry, potentially able to treat injuries and suppress reports.
Dr. Havel Rusk.persona: Careful, guarded, professional phrasing; avoids direct accusations; speaks as if every sentence could be repeated in court.

knowledge_about_others.Elsie Marrow: Knows her stress is genuine; she fears blame from owners.
knowledge_about_others.Father Kellan: Suspects the priest has seen sudden cash but can’t prove it.
knowledge_about_others.Inspector Mara Venn: Respects her; worries she’ll expose the foundry’s safety lapses.
knowledge_about_others.Sergeant Len Croft: Watches Croft’s temper; tries not to provoke him.

Dr. Havel Rusk.secret: Knows the foundry routinely ignores minor injuries; will downplay any burn reports to avoid scrutiny.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Rusk admits the town clinic’s ointment tins are issued sparingly and usually logged, but claims he did not personally treat the midnight patient.

Elsie Marrow.role: Foundry clerk; knows the safe combination circle and handles paperwork; could stage a clean theft.
Elsie Marrow.persona: Tense, precise, quick to bristle; when cornered, becomes brutally factual and lists names and procedures.

knowledge_about_others.Inspector Mara Venn: Believes Mara can keep owners from scapegoating her if Mara finds the truth.
knowledge_about_others.Sergeant Len Croft: Finds him intimidating; will cooperate if treated respectfully.
knowledge_about_others.Father Kellan: Sees him as a gossip conduit; suspects he knows more than he says.

Elsie Marrow.secret: Kept a private copy of shipping schedules to protect herself from blame; fears it will look like planning.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Elsie points out the punched break window and insists it contradicts witness statements, arguing someone manipulated records to craft an alibi.

Father Kellan.role: Parish priest; keeper of the donation ledger and confidences; could be laundering money—or noticing it.
Father Kellan.persona: Soft-spoken, firm boundaries; chooses words like prayers—careful, weighted, and occasionally accusatory in moral terms.

knowledge_about_others.Inspector Mara Venn: Will share facts if Mara agrees not to weaponize faith against the poor.
knowledge_about_others.Sergeant Len Croft: Sees Croft as judgment made flesh; keeps him at arm’s length.
knowledge_about_others.Elsie Marrow: Has heard her worries in passing; believes she is not the thief.
knowledge_about_others.Dr. Havel Rusk: Suspects Rusk knows more about injuries and late-night arrivals than he admits.

Father Kellan.secret: Protected the donor’s anonymity at first; fears scandal more than he fears the law, but will yield to clear evidence.

conditional_behaviors.reaction: Kellan confirms the cash donation was made the morning after the theft and admits the figure wore a work coat and cap pulled low.
